pages.title: Ringwoodite
pages.text: A high-pressure form of olivine from 520 km down. Its crystals hold water: there may be more of it in the mantle than in every ocean.

Made in $(item)Spectrograph$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ringwoodite Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Plume Elemental.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Deep Borehole chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Exoplanetology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pressure Boots, Pressure Chestplate, Pressure Helmet, Pressure Leggings.
